stories.title: Press Accountability or Press Purge? Trump Bans CNN, Politico and MS NOW as White House Launches Its Own 24/7 Channel
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Goes Direct: White House Launches Its Own Channel After Banning Outlets That Peddle 'Fiction and Lies'
stories.liberal_headline: Authoritarian Playbook: Trump Expels Reporters From White House, Replaces Them With State-Run Propaganda Channel
stories.poll_question: Can a president ban news outlets from the White House?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Access is a privilege; biased outlets don't deserve taxpayer-funded press credentials.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Punishing outlets for coverage is unconstitutional retaliation against a free press.

stories.title: Peace Through Strength or Endless War? Trump Tells the UN He May 'Annihilate' Iran in Month Eight
stories.conservative_headline: Trump to the World: Iran Will Never Get a Nuke — Deal or Devastation, the Choice Is Tehran's

stories.poll_option1_desc: Maximum pressure stopped Iran's bomb and forced Tehran to the table.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Eight months in with no exit, soaring fuel costs and no authorization.

stories.title: Iran War Tax or Biden's Hangover? Gas Above $4, Diesel at Records and Mortgage Rates at 2026 Highs
stories.conservative_headline: Resilient America: Jobs Beat Expectations and Retail Sales Surge Despite Wartime Energy Spike
stories.liberal_headline: Trump's War Is Hitting Your Wallet: $4 Gas, Record Diesel and Shrinking Paychecks Six Weeks From Midterms
stories.poll_question: Who's to blame for high prices right now?
stories.poll_option1_desc: War-driven oil shocks and past spending, not Trump's policies, drive prices.
stories.poll_option2_desc: His war and tariffs directly caused the fuel and grocery price spike.

stories.title: Enforcing the Law or Shooting an Asylum Seeker? Austin Bodycam Video of ICE Shooting a DoorDash Driver Goes Public
stories.conservative_headline: Bodycam Backs Agents: ICE Officer Confronted Man Defying a Final Deportation Order in Austin
stories.liberal_headline: Shot in the Back: Bodycam Shows ICE Agent Firing on Asylum Seeker With a Work Permit Delivering DoorDash
stories.poll_question: Was the ICE shooting in Austin justified?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Agents faced a fugitive defying removal; second-guessing them endangers officers.
stories.poll_option2_desc: An unarmed worker shot in the back demands prosecution and oversight.

stories.title: Judicial Restraint or Rigging the Map? Appeals Court Orders Missouri's GOP Map Used After SCOTUS Said No Twice
stories.conservative_headline: Appeals Court Sides With Missouri: Legislature's Map Will Be Used, Not One Drawn by Activist Judges
stories.liberal_headline: Twice Rejected by SCOTUS, Missouri's Extra-GOP-Seat Map Gets Forced Onto Midterm Ballots Anyway
stories.poll_question: Should Missouri's new GOP map be used in November?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Elected legislatures, not federal judges, draw congressional districts.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Mid-decade gerrymanders rejected by the high court shouldn't govern an election.

stories.title: Corruption Cleanup or Cover-Up? Report Says Trump Administration Dismantled the FBI Unit Probing Susan Collins
stories.conservative_headline: Another Weaponized Probe Shut Down: FBI's Rogue Squad Targeted a Sitting Republican Senator With No Charges
stories.liberal_headline: Trump's DOJ Killed the FBI Unit That Was Closing In on Susan Collins and a Defense Contractor's Illegal Cash
stories.poll_question: Why was the FBI corruption unit disbanded?
stories.poll_option1_desc: A politicized squad chasing Republicans without evidence deserved to be shut down.
stories.poll_option2_desc: The administration killed a live bribery probe to protect an ally.

stories.title: Fraud Busting or Coverage Purge? Vance Task Force Says Thousands Were 'Wrongly Signed Up' for Government Health Care

stories.liberal_headline: Vance's 'Fraud' Task Force Is Really a Pretext to Strip Health Coverage From Thousands of Americans

stories.poll_option1_desc: Taxpayers shouldn't fund ineligible enrollees; cleaning the rolls protects the program.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Mass disenrollment hurts eligible families under a phony fraud label.

stories.title: Innovation or Abdication? Trump Tells the UN AI Needs Fewer Guardrails as Data Center Bills Blow Up in Congress

stories.liberal_headline: Trump Green-Lights Unregulated AI at the UN While Voters Watch Data Centers Spike Their Electric Bills
stories.poll_question: Should Washington regulate AI and data centers now?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Regulation hands the AI race to China and kills American jobs.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Unchecked AI and data centers raise costs and endanger the public.

stories.title: Polluter Payback or Climate Lawfare? Supreme Court Weighs Boulder's Damages Case Against Exxon and Suncor

stories.poll_option1_desc: Energy policy belongs to Congress, not local juries chasing deep pockets.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Companies that misled the public should cover the damage they caused.
